description: This file manages the registration, retrieval, and validation of ACP runtime backends, including global state management and testing utilities.

methods.name: resolveAcpRuntimeRegistryGlobalState
methods.description: Resolves or initializes the global state for ACP runtime backends.

methods.name: normalizeBackendId
methods.description: Normalizes backend ID by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: isBackendHealthy
methods.description: Checks if a backend is healthy, considering optional healthy function.

methods.name: registerAcpRuntimeBackend
methods.description: Registers a new ACP runtime backend, ensuring it has a valid ID and runtime implementation.

methods.name: unregisterAcpRuntimeBackend
methods.description: Removes a backend from the registry by ID.

methods.name: getAcpRuntimeBackend
methods.description: Retrieves a backend by ID, or returns a healthy backend if no ID is provided.

methods.name: requireAcpRuntimeBackend
methods.description: Retrieves a backend by ID, throwing errors if not found or unhealthy.
